title: An approved operative proposal commits its DecisionRecord and ordinary Task atomically

given.actor: currently authorized Boss or granted Engineer with can_operate=true
given.proposal: the current pending measurement proposal with matching safe_task_request classification

when.command: the actor approves version 1 and selects keep_open

then.success: the locked pending proposal becomes approved version 2 for the same DecisionRecord, and one measurement Task consumes that flushed same-UoW source graph before all records, projections, and audit refs commit together
then.failure: a Task failure rolls back the DecisionRecord and every same-transaction transition or projection
then.safety: neither path grants Safety approval or creates an action Task
